# libheif and libde265

Built by the manual workflow .github/workflows/heif-dlls.yml (vcpkg, x64-windows,
decoding only). Licences: licenses/ (libheif and libde265 are under the GNU LGPL 3.0).
Versions and the vcpkg commit: VERSIONS.txt.

Sources: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif and https://github.com/strukturag/libde265
(the exact versions are the vcpkg ports listed in VERSIONS.txt).
